proof_attempt_summary: Three discovery solve rounds established exact-unbiased original-target calibration, observable covariance learning, uniform oracle transfer and no-harm, and a mixed-block normal limit; maximality strengthened the public oracle-residual variance completion and removed the count buffer. Math passed with no findings and all five probability citations verified-attested; D0.5 normalized the qualitative subfield assessment to incremental because the paper-score ceiling was 5.8, below 7.4. No Lean formalization was launched; one duplicate-certificate ballast finding and inaccessible final adjacent journal text remain disclosed, while scalable outcome-adaptive inference requires re-anchoring.
tldr: Exact stratified invitation counts couple graph-excluded training assignments to evaluation assignments. Conditional-score calibration preserves the original-design marginal invitation contrast and learns its projection coefficients from observable local outcome moments. The proved package gives exact finite-population unbiasedness, uniform mean-square oracle equivalence, asymptotic variance no-harm, a primitive-derived mixed-block normal limit and conservative connected ninety-percent Wald coverage. The interval uses an exact public worst-table completion of the oracle-residual covariance, which is no larger than the former unadjusted completion and can be strictly smaller. Fixed covariate dimension and bounded forward and reverse neighborhood sizes make this a specialized methods contribution.
gap: Yu, Zhao and Liu leave complete randomization open in Section 8. Lu et al. already resolve no-interference conditional cross-fitting under complete and stratified designs. Accessible generic coefficient-learning results do not certify the declared original-target network package under hard totals.
fill: The focal object is feasible original-target conditional-score calibration: exact public split coefficients localize its unknown covariance, graph-excluded inclusion weighting learns that covariance, and mixed-block weighted cumulants support an actual-design limit and conservative interval.
